title: 192 Lasers Hit 500 Trillion Watts, 1,000 Times America's Power

scenes.text: One laser shot hit 500 trillion watts.
That is about a thousand times the power the US is using at that moment.
It happened at the National Ignition Facility in California.
192 laser beams fire together at a target about two millimeters wide.
It lasts only a split second.
The goal is to squeeze atoms together like inside a star.

description:
The National Ignition Facility fired 192 laser beams at once and hit a peak power of over 500 trillion watts.
That is about a thousand times the power the US uses at any instant, for a split second.
What would you power with it?
first_comment: Would you want fusion power in your city?
